Mrs. Ranjana Manoj Mimani has resigned as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director of Nibe Limited with effect from September 29, 2026, citing pre-occupancy and a recent appointment in a Singapore-based company.

Consequently, she ceases to be the Chairperson of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee, with confirmation that there are no other material reasons for her resignation.

news.headline:
Artemis Medicare Services received a Show Cause Notice from CGST Gurugram claiming Rs. 11.2 Crore plus interest and penalty for FY 2022-23, alleging unremitted GST collected on medicines, consumables, and implants charged to in-patients.

A similar earlier notice is already stayed by the Punjab & Haryana High Court, and the company is filing a writ petition for this notice as well to connect it with the previous one.

Source: ScoutQuest
